notes.title: Updates # 5.3
notes.notes:
The new update fixes a bug with keeping items after finishing levels. Now even the installed shield is transferred to the next level. We hope that our community will spend a little time to test the game.

The next update will be "BIG": we are planning to open local multiplayer for testing - up to 5 players will be available. You can use joysticks and several USB keyboards, our game can handle each keyboard separately! Follow our news!

notes.title: Updates # 5.2
notes.notes:
[list]
 [*]Added new levels - now 31.
 [*]Improved character animation.
 [*]Now there is an opportunity to go down through the "thin crossbeams" when you press the button down.
 [*]The control has improved slightly: If you hold the up key in flight, the main character now hangs in the air for an unlimited time (now, it's impossible to fall into a tailspin ːsteamhappyː. Also, moving left and right in flight is in the "arcade" style (no inertia).
 [*]Partly changed the control on the gamepad. There is information on the layout in the instructions on the start screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update # 5.1
notes.notes:
Improved controls, movement to the left and right became more sensitive. The character can briefly plan in the air, which allows you to see the enemies below.

Improved checkpoint ːCheckpointBlackEyeː, the star appears when checkpoint is active.

Added 10 new levels, now the game has 21 levels.

notes.title: BIG update #A5! BlackEye got better. Your wishes are taken into account: Improved handling, camera, balance!
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Improved interface, now the game starts with the main menu.
(with magnificent view of the planet Kotee in the background ːsteamhappyː

[*] Added instructions for the layout of the keyboard and game-pad (in the future these images will be replaced with short training videos).

[*] Improved camera performance (now the camera will look in the direction of the character's movement) +now there are new combination of keys to look up or down (Space-bar + Up, Down, Stick, or Start + Stick Up, Down).

[*] Added temporary invulnerability after loss of life (8 seconds).

[*] Added "The Suicide Function": the game has physics (this is a fact), which sometimes leads to the fact that the character is overwhelmed with heavy things and can not move, when you have only one choice left, act like a real samurai ːsteamhappyː
[/olist]
[b]!!! AND Oh YES,[/b] we are working on "local multiplayer". There will be a cooperative mode and the “PVP” mode !!! The new mode will be available in one of the next big updates !!! Support us with your purchases and we will try to make not only local multiplayer, but an online mode!

2. Game balance improved.

notes.title: Update # 3
notes.notes:
[b]Added new artifacts:[/b]

[olist]
    [*]Shield that protects the hero from the enemies. 
Collecting these artifacts your  protection will increase, so that the character suffers less damage from the enemies.

    [*]First aid kit 3% and 5% of health.
Artifacts are stored in the "right" inventory. Use the Right Ctrl to select the pickup, to use it press Right Shift. On the gamepad use RT to select the pickup, to use the pickup press RB.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update # 2
notes.notes:
Intermediate update: the energy scale is added to the interface, this resource can be replenished, but so far it does not participate in the game process.
Continuing to improve the game levels.

The "right-hand" inventory (Right Ctrl or RT) is added. Now you can carry your health with you. Of course, if you find it ...))))))
